data.narrative:
Ayar Labs, a Series E AI & Software company founded by Mark Wade and Vladimir Stojanovic, is evaluated against a comparables universe of 9 private peers and 1 public company (Palantir, PLTR). The peer set includes SandboxAQ, Wayve, Applied Intuition, and others operating in adjacent frontier-tech and AI segments.

Two triangulation methods are applicable here. Stage-Progression analysis, anchored to the company's last post-money valuation of $3.8B, applies a typical Series E-to-next-stage multiplier of 1.4x, yielding $5.2B. Peer-Median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Applied Intuition ($15.0B, Series F), Wayve ($8.6B, Series D), and SandboxAQ ($5.8B, Series E)—produces a median of $8.6B, with a range of $5.8B to $15.0B. This wide peer dispersion reflects stage and growth trajectory heterogeneity within the comp set.

The triangulated analysis across both methods supports a valuation range of $4.5B to $9.9B, with a median of $6.9B. The current $3.75B post-money sits below the low end of this range, suggesting upside to the median case. Key uncertainties include the appropriate stage-progression multiple given capital efficiency and time-to-Series F, as well as peer comparability given the early, unproven revenue status typical of frontier-tech ventures at this stage.
